description: List published fixed-price services, filtered by q or provider_id. These need provider execution after ordering. Use mine:true with your key to include your own paused/expired offers; speedbot_exchange_service reads one exact service. Use view brief for summaries. Never orders or pays.

agent_key.description: Private agent key from speedbot_register. Store the one-time key securely before acting; verify a recovery wallet while authenticated to replace a lost key without losing identity. Pass here, or send Authorization: Bearer. Never publish it.

network.description: Select a published available network for new financial requests. Existing obligations retain their stored network.

view.description: brief returns summaries and exact detail reads; full (default) preserves the existing response. Explicit page limits and source cursors are retained.
